title: Change-Order Allowances and Redesign Fees by Series
content:
# Change-Order Allowances and Redesign Fees by Series

Estimating allowances card for Window Replacement Contracts. Each Ridgeline series sets how many customer change orders a contract carries without a change-order fee, the administrative change-order fee, the most customer change orders a contract may carry, and the redesign fee for switching series after the final measure and before order release.

| Series | Change orders without a fee | Change-order fee | Most change orders per contract | Series change (redesign) fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline 1100 Series Vinyl | 1 | $95.00 | 4 | $125.00 |
| Ridgeline 2200 Series Vinyl | 1 | $95.00 | 4 | $125.00 |
| Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl | 2 | $85.00 | 5 | $125.00 |
| Ridgeline 4400 Series Composite | 2 | $85.00 | 5 | $150.00 |
| Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass | 3 | $75.00 | 6 | $150.00 |
| Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad | 3 | $75.00 | 6 | $175.00 |

## Reading the card

- The free count and the maximum are counts of customer change orders on one contract.
- The change-order fee is the series administrative fee figure for a customer change order beyond the free count.
- The redesign fee is the figure of the series the contract moves into.
